ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an astable multivibrator composed of a 555 timer. R1 is connected from VCC to the discharge terminal pin 7 of the 555, R2 is connected from pin 7 to the node where pins 2 and 6 are connected; C1 is connected from the pins 2 and 6 node to ground. Pins 8 and 4 are connected to VCC, pin 1 is grounded, pin 3 outputs uo, and pin 5 is connected to ground through C2. Reasoning: This is a standard 555 astable circuit, the oscillation period is determined by R1, R2, and C1, and C2 is only the control terminal bypass capacitor. The formula is T = 0.693(R1 + 2R2)C1. Substitute R1 = 3 kΩ, R2 = 2 kΩ, C1 = 0.01 μF: R1 + 2R2 = 3 kΩ + 2×2 kΩ = 7 kΩ. T = 0.693×7 kΩ×0.01 μF. Because 1 kΩ·μF = 1 ms, T = 0.693×0.07 ms = 0.04851 ms = 48.51 μs, approximately 49 μs.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit connections in the image: pins 2 and 6 sense the voltage on C1, pin 7 discharges through R2, and the output is pin 3. Compute the high/charging interval as tH = ln2·(R1 + R2)C1 because C1 rises from 1/3VCC to 2/3VCC through R1 and R2. Compute the low/discharging interval as tL = ln2·R2C1 because the discharge transistor at pin 7 discharges C1 through R2 from 2/3VCC to 1/3VCC. Add them: T = ln2·(R1 + 2R2)C1. Substitute R1 = 3 kΩ, R2 = 2 kΩ, C1 = 0.01 μF to get approximately 48.5 μs, hence about 49 μs.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个 555 定时器无稳态振荡电路。555 的 8 脚和 4 脚接到上方的 VCC 电源线，1 脚接地；3 脚为输出端，标为 u_o；5 脚通过 C2 接地。左侧 R1 从 VCC 接到中间节点，该节点连接 555 的 7 脚；R2 从该中间节点接到下方节点，下方节点同时连接 555 的 2 脚、6 脚以及电容 C1 的上端，C1 下端接地。因此 2、6 脚检测 C1 电压，7 脚通过 R2 对 C1 放电。推理：555 无稳态电路中，C1 由 1/3VCC 充到 2/3VCC 时，充电路径经过 R1 和 R2，所以高电平时间 tH = ln2·(R1+R2)C1。C1 由 2/3VCC 放到 1/3VCC 时，7 脚内部放电管导通，放电路径主要经过 R2，所以低电平时间 tL = ln2·R2·C1。周期 T = tH + tL = ln2·(R1+2R2)C1。代入 R1=3 kΩ，R2=2 kΩ，C1=0.01 μF：R1+2R2 = 3 kΩ + 4 kΩ = 7 kΩ，T = 0.693 × 7 kΩ × 0.01 μF = 0.693 × 7000 × 1e-8 s = 4.851e-5 s = 48.51 μs，约为 49 μs。
